name: Sales Dashboard
description: Record sales and explore them as a filterable table, headline totals and a daily chart
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read sales, the summary and the daily series; require auth for creating, updating and deleting sales; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Sale validation: product is a required non-empty string of at most 100 characters; amount is the sale's total value, a number greater than 0 and at most 1000000, stored with 2 decimal places; quantity is a whole number of at least 1; date is a date (YYYY-MM-DD) no later than today and defaults to today
On first start with no sales, seed about 40 sample sales spread over the previous 60 days across a handful of products

GET /api/sales returns active sales, newest date first; ?start_date= and ?end_date= keep sales dated within that inclusive range, ?product= keeps sales of exactly that product (ignoring case), ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 25, at most 100), and total counts every matching sale

GET /api/sales/summary returns total_sales (sum of amount), total_transactions (number of sales), average_sale (total_sales divided by total_transactions, rounded to 2 decimals, 0 without sales) and total_quantity, for the same ?start_date=, ?end_date= and ?product= filters
GET /api/sales/daily returns one entry per calendar day in the filtered range that has sales, oldest first, with that day's amount total and number of sales; it accepts the same filters
Any signed-in user may update or delete any sale; PUT /api/sales/:id replaces product, amount, quantity and date, and DELETE /api/sales/:id removes the sale permanently
Deactivated sales (is_active false) are left out of the lists, the summary and the daily series, and answer 404 on the public sale endpoints; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input or an end_date before start_date, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the dashboard read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit and delete controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to record sales' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Headline cards at the top for total sales, number of transactions and average sale, matching the current filters
A bar chart of daily sales totals for the current filters, with dates on the x axis and amounts on the y axis
A date range filter with 'This month', 'Last month' and custom start/end dates, plus a product filter; the cards, chart and table all follow it
Sales table with date, product, quantity and amount columns and previous/next paging
Add and edit sale forms (product, amount, quantity, date defaulting to today) that show the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every sale, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a sale's active status from the overview

data_models.name: Sale
data_models.description: One recorded sale; summaries and the daily series are computed from active sales

fields.amount: decimal (required, > 0, at most 1000000, 2 decimal places; a number in JSON)
fields.date: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today, not in the future)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the sale from public endpoints and totals)
